name: io.github.mirackacmazcom/seo-skills
title: SEO Skills
description: Search primary-source SEO archives: Google leak, patents, official docs, staff statements.

tools.name: google_leak
tools.description:
Searches the leaked Google Content Warehouse API documentation (the 2024 "Google leak"): 2,756 schemas and 15,050 fields, each with the description Google's engineers wrote, its type and the revisions it appears in. Returns matching schemas and fields, a whole schema, references between schemas, or a field's revision history. The documents define data structures; they do not state ranking weights.

The "args" parameter takes the command-line arguments of the search tool. Examples:
- search navboost
- search click --name-only
- field siteAuthority
- show CompressedQualitySignals
- show PerDocData --brief
- show PerDocData --match spam --match scam
- refs QualityNsrNsrData
- history PerDocData --match hostAge
- list QualityNavboost
- stats --revisions
["--help"] and [<command>, "--help"] list all options.

tools.name: google_maps_ranking
tools.description:
Searches an archive of primary sources on ranking in Google Maps, local search and Google Business Profile: 326 Google patent families, 111 official Google documents, 45 statements by Google employees and 26 Google Research papers (November 2026). Returns matching entries with the source name, date, a summary or abstract and the link, and can list the patents by category.

The "args" parameter takes the command-line arguments of the search tool. Examples:
- search review ranking signal
- search distance --type statement
- search business name keyword --type doc
- search prominence --type patent --category 1
- show US7822751B2
- category
- category 4
- stats
["--help"] and [<command>, "--help"] list all options.

tools.name: google_patents
tools.description:
Searches an archive of Google's patents on search, ranking, crawling, indexing, site quality, links, user behaviour, query understanding and web performance: 54,101 publications in 10,491 families, with full text for US publications. Returns matching patents, bibliographic data, claims, numbered description paragraphs, family members, inventors and topics.

The "args" parameter takes the command-line arguments of the search tool. Examples:
- search site quality score
- search '"anchor text"' link --in claims --granted
- search generative summary --ai --from 2022
- show US9031929B1
- claims US9031929B1 --independent
- passages US8661029B1 click viewing time
- find US7346839B2 sandbox
- show US9031929B1 --section description --full
- family US6285999
- inventor Navneet Panda
- topics
- stats
["--help"] and [<command>, "--help"] list all options.

tools.name: google_ai_patents
tools.description:
Searches an archive of AI patents of Google and the Alphabet companies (DeepMind, Waymo, Verily and others): 82,806 publications in 14,495 families, with full text for almost every family. Covers generative search and AI Overviews, query decomposition, source and passage selection, embeddings and retrieval, model architectures, assistants and agents. Returns matching patents, claims, numbered description paragraphs, family members, inventors, topics and company groups.

The "args" parameter takes the command-line arguments of the search tool. Examples:
- search generative summary search results --ai
- search sub-queries decomposition --search --from 2023
- search mixture of experts --group deepmind
- search '"synthetic queries"' --in claims --granted
- show US11769017B1
- claims US11769017B1 --independent
- passages US11769017B1 linkify verification
- find US11769017B1 "search result"
- family US11769017B1
- inventor Noam Shazeer
- topics
- groups
- stats
["--help"] and [<command>, "--help"] list all options.

tools.name: llm_patents
tools.description:
Searches an archive of patent publications worldwide whose text mentions large language models: 157,165 publications in 99,911 families, with full text for US publications and title and abstract for other countries. Can be filtered by company (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, Baidu and others). Returns matching patents, claims, numbered description paragraphs, family members, inventors and topics.

The "args" parameter takes the command-line arguments of the search tool. Examples:
- stats
- search language model plugin api --core
- search search results summary --company microsoft --core --granted
- search search engine --company perplexity
- search prompt cache --company openai --core
- search '"generative response engine"' --in claims --granted
- show US11922144B1
- claims US11922144B1 --independent
- passages US11922144B1 manifest web api
- find US11922144B1 plugin
- family US11922144B1
- inventor Andrey Mishchenko
- topics
["--help"] and [<command>, "--help"] list all options.

tools.name: google_search_docs
tools.description:
Searches an archive of Google's official documentation on search and SEO: 3,630 documents from Search Central, the Search Central blog, Search Console Help, How Search Works, the Search Quality Rater Guidelines, web.dev, Chrome for Developers and PageSpeed Insights, captured on 11 November 2026. Returns matching documents and sections with their title, date and address, a whole section, the most relevant paragraphs of a long document, or whether an exact phrase occurs.

The "args" parameter takes the command-line arguments of the search tool. Examples:
- search canonical duplicate
- search '"crawl budget"' --in core
- search '"core update"' --in blog --from 2024 --strict --sort date
- search INP threshold --in perf
- show docs/essentials/spam-policies
- show docs/essentials/spam-policies --section 12
- show docs/crawling-indexing/301-redirects --translation
- passages sqrg YMYL harm
- find "E-E-A-T itself isn't a specific ranking factor"
- list docs --path structured-data --limit 200
- refs docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content
- stats
["--help"] and [<command>, "--help"] list all options.

tools.name: google_staff_statements
tools.description:
Searches an archive of public statements by eight members of Google's Search team (John Mueller, Gary Illyes, Martin Splitt, Danny Sullivan, Daniel Waisberg, Cherry Prommawin, Lizzi Sassman, Rajan Patel): 47,388 items from social media, forums, Search Central videos and office hours, podcasts and interviews. Returns matching statements with the person, platform, date, the question being answered and the link, a full thread or transcript passage, or a timeline on a topic.

The "args" parameter takes the command-line arguments of the search tool. Examples:
- search canonical hreflang
- search '"crawl budget"' -k illyes
- search disavow -k mueller --from 2023 --sort date
- search "core update" -k sullivan -p x,bluesky
- search "AI content" --in-question
- search "domain authority" --question-only -k mueller
- show 2258
- show 31270 --at 26:40
- find "isn't a ranking factor" -k mueller
- timeline "subdomain" -k mueller -n 30
- people
- stats
["--help"] and [<command>, "--help"] list all options.
